title: trifolium badium subsp. spadiceum
intro: Trifolium badium subsp. spadiceum, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial herb belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing menopausal symptoms, alleviating osteoporosis, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Red Clover are attributed to its ability to act as an estrogen modulator, anti-inflammatory agent, and antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, particularly genistein and daidzein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
